Perks › Rare

Fresh Cut

Rare perk · Draft

Once per draft per stack, upgrade the lower-rarity perk offer by one rarity tier.

In-game card text

How it works

Once per draft for each copy, upgrade the lowest-rarity positive card in the offer by one rarity tier: Common to Uncommon, Uncommon to Rare, and so on.

The new card is a random perk of that tier that you have unlocked. Online, it can be any perk of that tier the match allows, so an Epic card can become a Legendary one.

  • It never upgrades the Malus card, and it never creates a second copy of a card already offered at the new tier.
  • A Legendary card cannot be upgraded further.
  • It is not available in All In or Legendary Table drafts.
